criteria.criterion: Navigate Xbox.com to the 'Best sellers' section
criteria.final_justification: Although action history suggests the agent clicked a game from a Best sellers list, the screenshots do not corroborate that a “Best sellers” section was actually located/visible. With no visual evidence of reaching “Best sellers,” the baseline score should be reduced to partial credit for reasonable navigation effort to the Games area.

criteria.criterion: Open a product page for a game from 'Best sellers'
criteria.final_justification: The agent did open a valid product page on Xbox.com (confirmed). But the requirement that it was selected from the “Best sellers” section is not verifiable from screenshot evidence (no linkage shown). Award partial credit: product page opened, provenance unclear.

criteria.criterion: Report publisher, developer, and release date from the product page
criteria.final_justification: All required fields are clearly available on the product page (per Screenshot 7), but the agent failed to report the publisher despite it being visible and instead stated it was unavailable. This is a critical omission/contradiction relative to the page evidence. Since 2 of 3 fields were reported correctly, award substantial but not full credit.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in; no purchase or download; stop after recording details)
criteria.final_justification: No evidence of signing in, purchasing, or downloading. The agent stopped after attempting to record details (even though they missed publisher in the final output). Constraints appear respected, so keep full credit.
